text: Notification. The Competent Authority has approved that the students should have a minimum attendance of 75% to become eligible for appearing in the End Semester Examination with effect from the current semester onwards i.e. AY 2022-23 (odd semester onwards). Date: 08th September, 2022.

28. Attendance Requirements. (a) All undergraduate students are expected to be present in every lecture, tutorial, practical or project interaction session scheduled for them. (b) A student must have a minimum attendance of 75% in a course during a semester, in lectures, tutorials or practicals taken together. A student with less than 75% attendance in a course will be awarded an X grade in that course irrespective of his/her performance in the tests during the semester.

b. To continue to get the scholarship, the students should maintain their academic proficiency (minimum 6.5 CGPA) & without any backlogs. If students cannot reach minimum standard of renewal scholarship policy, the scholarship would be withdrawn. d. Students must apply every year for the continuation of the scholarship on or before the last date as announced every year, failing which scholarship would be withdrawn for that academic year.

Continuation of Merit Scholarship in subsequent years is subject to obtaining CGPA as per the table given below, having no backlog and no discipline case being recorded against the student. Minimum CGPA Required: B.Tech AI 8.5 & above. B.Tech Computer Science Engineering. BA (Hons.) Psychology.

iii. Performance Criteria: A student with CGPA of 8.5 and above (in case of B.Tech. AI) and 8 and above for other programs on a scale of 10 will be awarded Academic Scholarship of 10% of Tuition Fees, provided the student is among the top 10% performers in that program. iv. A student who is already on an existing Admission scholarship is not eligible for Academic Scholarship.

A student missing the Mid Term Examination shall be required to take a make-up Examination. The students must put up the request for a make-up examination along with the medical documents within 5 days of the last date of the examination. The genuineness shall be reviewed and approved by the School Dean and Dean Academic and finally put up to the Vice Chancellor for approval.

The make-up Examination shall be held between Mid Term and End Semester Examination and the dates shall be notified in the academic calendar. In case a student misses the make-up examination, then no further chance will be provided. The duration of the examination shall be as decided by the Faculty/Course Coordinator.
In case a student misses the make-up Examination also, then no further chance will be provided. The duration of Examination shall be as decided by the Faculty/course coordinator.
Credit Assignment. Lectures/Tutorials: One lecture/tutorial hour per week per semester is assigned one credit. Practicals: One laboratory hour per week per semester is assigned half credit.
The duration of the programs leading to degrees of B. Tech shall be minimum four years. However, the duration may be extended up-to six years from the date of initial registration.
A student must have a CGPA of at least 1.67 to be declared promoted to the next class subject to: (i) Maximum duration permitted for completion of B.Tech program is six years.
Maximum duration permitted for completion of B.Tech program is six years. (ii) No relaxation in credit limit beyond 28 credits will be allowed for registration.
Withdrawals due to medical reasons are not counted in six years. Forced withdrawal of students shall count in the maximum period of six years and minimum period of four years.
Programmable calculators are not allowed in the examination hall. Calculators up to fx 100 are only allowed.
Mobile phones or any other electronic gadgets except calculators will not be carried inside the Examination Hall.

NP and NF Grades. Applications for the Audit Course are allowed during the first two weeks of a semester. The audit pass (NP) grade is awarded, if minimum marks equivalent to D grade are obtained in that course and attendance is above 75% in the classes.
The audit pass (NP) grade is awarded if attendance is above 75% in the classes. If either of these requirements is not fulfilled, the audit fail (NF) grade is awarded.
The Controller of Examination will be appointed/nominated by the Vice-Chancellor, as and when required.
Seating plan and invigilation duties are assigned by the examination committee before every examination.
A student who is expelled from the hostel on disciplinary ground shall forfeit the amount deposited towards hostel charges for the semester.
